check_point: Site Inspection: Site Inspection done to evaluate existing conditions, obstructions including underground service lines if any?
Visual Documentation: Documentation done for the current status of nearby structures through photos, videos or other records?
Clearing the Site: Site clearance done for vegetation, debris, and obstructions as necessary before excavation begins?
Excavation Planning: Excavation plan done specifying depths, slopes, and locations for different areas within the site.
Plan for Dewatering: Has a plan for dewatering been established to manage water levels effectively during excavation?
Excavation Safety: Are safety measures, including protective gear and barriers, implemented to ensure worker safety during excavation and safety training provided to workers and equipment operators?
Excavation Equipment: Has the excavation equipment been checked to ensure that it is in good working condition including operator license, equipment insurance etc?
Verification of Documents: Have documents such as operator licenses, equipment insurance, and other relevant documents been verified?
Checking the Dimension: Are the trench dimensions verified to conform to the specifications outlined in the construction drawings?
Soil Excavation: Was the excavation checked based on the drawing?
Adequate Working Spaces: Has confirmation been made that there are sufficient working spaces provided all around the excavation area for safe and efficient work?
Embankment Construction: Have you checked if the embankments are made with the specified dimensions, slopes, and compaction requirements?
Slope Stability: Are the slopes checked to ensure they are stable and safe for excavation?
Drainage Considerations: Has the drainage design and installation been checked to ensure dewatering of waterlogged areas?
Support and Access Provision: Have proper support structures and access points been provided for the excavated sides to ensure safety and ease of work?
Barricading and Caution Signs: Are appropriate barricades and caution signs in place for safety purposes?
Record Keeping: Are relevant records maintained for excavation and quality control activities, including measurements?
Safety Inspections: Have safety inspections been conducted and ensured safety in the excavated area?
Final Inspection: Was the final inspection conducted before proceeding to the next phase?
Site Clean-up: Has the site been cleaned of debris and materials after earthwork is completed?
Review the Plans: Were architectural and structural AFC drawings checked and found OK?
Site Inspection and Preparation: Has the existing features, boundaries, obstacles been checked? Has vegetation been cleared, and the site prepared accordingly?
Establish Baselines: Have reference baselines and sub-baselines been checked and established as per drawings?
Benchmarks: Have permanent benchmarks been established?
Grid Lines: Have grid lines been established in both directions?
Survey Equipments: Are all survey equipment available and checked for usability calibration?
Marking Tools: Have necessary layout tools, such as chalk lines, marking paint, and pegs been checked?
Setbacks: Have setbacks been checked in accordance with the drawings?
Safety Measures: Have safety precautions been checked for setting-out points?
Record Keeping: Is detailed records of measurements being maintained?
Quality Control: Have measurements been checked for accuracy, including the right angle and diagonals?
Issue Resolution: Have deviations identified during the setting-out process been effectively addressed and resolved as per the standard procedure?
Final Inspection: Was a final inspection conducted before proceeding to the next phase of work?
Site Preparation: Has the piling site been prepared, obstructions cleared, and safe access ensured for piling equipment?
Line & Level Preparation: Have reference lines and levels been established for precise pile positioning according to the design specifications?
Adjacent Pile Spacing: Is the correct spacing between adjacent piles checked and maintained as per project requirements?
Reinforcement Details: Have the type, size, and arrangement of reinforcement bars or cages been verified as per the structural drawing?
Cover Block Placement: Is the proper placement of cover blocks ensured to protect reinforcement and maintain concrete cover?
Working Condition of Equipment: Have piling equipment been inspected to ensure they are in working condition?
Quality of Construction Material: Has the quality of construction materials, including concrete, steel been tested & verified?
Concrete Mix Design: Has the concrete mix design been checked to meet the specified strength and durability?
Safety Measures: Have safety protocols been implemented, and protective gear provided to ensure the safety of workers and the site?
Quality Control Procedures: Have quality control measures including QTBT been implemented to ensure compliance with design specifications and industry standards?
Rig Placing: Has the rig placed properly over the pile location for accurate driving?
Centering of Casing: Is the casing correctly centered over the pile location?
Density of Bentonite Slurry: Is the proper density of bentonite slurry being monitored and maintained for supporting the borehole and stabilizing the soil?
Taking of Soil Samples: Have soil samples been collected from the borehole for geotechnical testing and analysis?
Number of Blows for SPT 'N': Have the number of blows required to achieve the specified 'N' value during the Standard Penetration Test (SPT) for soil characterization been recorded?
Reinforcement Details: Is the placement and alignment of reinforcement bars or cages inside the pile continuously monitored during driving?
Safety Measures: Are safety protocols and protective gear consistently enforced during the piling process?
Actual Cement Consumption: Has the actual cement consumption for pile concreting been calculated and documented, and has it been compared to the estimated consumption?
Concrete Test and Samples: Has slump tests are conducted during the concrete and cube samples are prepared as per the standard requirements.
Maintaining Bore Log: Are detailed borehole logs being maintained, including soil and rock information, borehole dimensions, drilling conditions and reinforment details for future reference?
Safety Measures: Have all safety precautions been checked and implemented?
Material Quality: Has the quality of backfill materials been checked?
Backfilling Compliance: Is backfilling being done in layers as specified?
Moisture Management: Are appropriate moisture levels being maintained during backfilling?
Inspection and Testing: Is regular inspection and testing of backfill work being conducted?
Compaction Compliance: Does the compaction meet the specified standards?
Backfill Level Compliance: Is the backfilling done up to the specified levels as required?
Surplus Earth Disposal: Has the disposal of surplus earth from the work site been confirmed?
Pre-Inspection: Has the area been inspected to assess termite infestation?
Safety Precautions: Are safety measures for workers and occupants being implemented?
Chemical Selection: Have appropriate termiticides and chemicals been chosen?
Chemical Concentration: Is the concentration of the chemical emulsion within the AJeptable range?
Earthwork Completion: Has earthwork for the treated area been completed?
Equipment Condition: Is the spraying equipment, such as pumps, in good working condition?
Warranties and Guarantees: Have the warranties or guarantees provided by the pest control professional been verified?
Surface Preparation: Have surfaces been prepared by removing obstructions and debris?
Hole-Making Intervals and Depth: Is there consistency in hole-making intervals and depth for effective treatment?
Uniform Chemical Application: Has the chemical emulsion been uniformly applied?
Monitoring and Inspection: Is post-treatment monitoring and periodic inspection being implemented?
Record Keeping: Are records of treatment, chemical use, and inspection results being maintained?
Post-Treatment Actions: Have any recommended post-treatment actions been followed up?
Review Plans and Drawings: Have the architectural, structural plans and AFC Drawings been reviewed?
Material Inspection: Has the quality and dimensions of shuttering materials (plywood, timber, steel, etc.) been inspected?
Site Preparation: Is the site level and prepared for shuttering?
Layout and Marking: Have the layout and dimensions for the shuttering been accurately marked?
Safety Measures: Are safety precautions for workers and the surrounding area being implemented?
Proper Alignment and Leveling: Is the shuttering level, plumb, and aligned with the design plans?
Secure Joints: Have joints and gaps in the shuttering been securely fastened to prevent the leakage of concrete?
Adequate Tie Rods and Reinforcement: Are tie rods and reinforcement correctly placed in the shuttering for structural stability?
Properly Supported Props: Are all wooden/steel props supported on a rigid, flat surface and tightly secured?
Bracing System: Is the support system properly braced for stability?
Side Support Inspection: Have the side supports of each beam been checked to eliminate the chance of bulging?
Location of Openings: Has the location of spouts, inserts, or openings been verified according to the design?
Sunken Flat Area Position: Is the level and position of sunken flat areas in accordance with specifications?
Cleaning and Preparation: Has the formwork been thoroughly cleaned before starting the reinforcement work?
Waste Disposal: Are waste materials being disposed of according to the environmental regulations?
Review Structural Plans: Have the structural plans, reinforcement details and AFC drawings been thoroughly checked?
Brand of steel: Mention the brand the steel in the remark column
Material Inspection: Has the quality and dimensions of reinforcement bars (rebar) and mesh been inspected?
Bar Bending Schedule: Does the bar bending schedule match the structural drawings?
Fabrication at Yard: Has sample fabrication of each type of bar been done at the fabrication yard, with dimensions checked and cut length verified before mass production?
Storage and Handling: Is there proper storage and handling of reinforcement materials to prevent damage?
Safety Measures: Are safety precautions for workers and the construction site being implemented?
Bar Alignment and Spacing: Are the reinforcement bars aligned and spaced correctly according to the design specifications?
Overlaps and Lapping: Have laps been staggered, lap lengths checked and recorded, and spacer bars provided wherever necessary and recorded?
Chairs or Supports: Are chairs or spacers being used to maintain the correct cover (distance between bars and formwork)?
Structural earthing: Is structural Earthing works are done?
Proper Spacing and Cover Blocks: Is the spacing of bars and stirrups in adherence to the drawings, and are a sufficient number of cover blocks of specified thickness being used?
Safety Standards Compliance: Are safety standards and regulations being followed during the placement of reinforcement?
Tie Wire and Fastening: Is appropriate tie wire and fasteners being used to secure the reinforcement in place?
Construction Joint Reinforcement: At construction joints, have all reinforcement bars extending to the future concreting been provided?
Inserts and Tying: Are inserts fixed in the correct location and tied properly to the reinforcement?
Inspection and Quality Check: Has the reinforcement been inspected for quality, and does it adhere to the design specifications?
Cover and Protective Measures: Is the specified concrete cover being maintained, and are there adequate protective measures in place for the reinforcement?
Post-Pour Reinforcement Inspection: After pouring concrete, has a post-pour inspection been conducted to check for any misplacement or shifting of reinforcement?
Dimensions, Line, Level, Plumb: Are dimensions, alignment, level, and plumb in accordance with design specifications?
Prop Support: Are wooden/steel props properly supported at the bottom on a rigid flat surface and secure?
Support Bracing: Is the support system adequately braced for stability?
Prop Individual Check: Have each prop been individually inspected to ensure they are resting on a rigid base?
Spouts/Inserts/ Openings: Are the location and provision of spouts, inserts, and openings verified?
Sunken Slab Area: Is the level and position of sunken slab areas checked?
Shuttering Gaps: Have all gaps in shuttering, which may cause leakage or slurry, been filled or rectified?
Rebar Work: Is the rebar work following the drawing and free from rust?
Formwork and Staging: Is the formwork and staging inspected for accuracy, strength, and finish?
Cover to Reinforcement: Is the cover to reinforcement verified as per specifications?
Material Quality: Has the quality and availability of materials been checked?
Labor Strength: Is there sufficient labor for the job?
Platform Safety: Is the platform safe for both workers and materials?
MEP Clearance: Has MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) clearance been obtained?
Equipment Condition: Is the working condition of equipment to be used checked?
Testing Equipment Ready: Are there sufficient cube molds and a slump cone ready for concrete testing?
Construction Joints Preparation: Are construction joints prepared according to standards?
Pour Plan Submission: Has a pour plan been submitted for large concrete?
Proper Concrete Placement: Is the concrete confirmed to be placed properly?
Vibration/Compaction: Is the concrete adequately vibrated or compacted?
Cube and Slump Testing: Have the slump test conducted and the number of cubes been taken as per concrete quantity?
Surface Level and Plumb: Is the surface level and plumb maintained as required?
Bonding Agents: Have the use of approved bonding agents been checked and ensured as required?
Concrete Quantity Record: Has the theoretical and actual quantity of concrete used been recorded?
Curing/Ponding: Is proper curing or ponding confirmed to be provided for the concrete?
Work Done Date: Is the work done date prominently displayed on vertical RCC members?
Surface Condition: Has the surface condition been inspected after concreting?
Stripping of Shuttering: Is the stripping of shuttering done within the specified duration?
Shutter Cleaning: Has the shuttering been cleaned and is it ready for reuse?
Documentation: Are records of batching report, inspection results and any relevant documentation being maintained?
Waste Disposal: Is the disposal of waste materials and containers done in accordance with environmental regulations?
Review Masonry Plans: Have the architectural and structural plans for masonry details been reviewed?
Material Inspection: Has the quality and dimensions of blocks/bricks, mortar, and other materials been inspected?
Safety Measures: Are safety precautions for workers and the construction site being implemented?
Work Area Cleaning: Has the work area been cleaned of loose mortar, concrete debris, and any hacking remnants?
Provision of concrete kerb: Has concrete kerb been provided at required areas as per standard procedure?
Mixing sheets: Arranged for mixing sheet for mortar mixing?
DPC: DPC is provided for all external walls as required.
Alignment and Location: Have the alignment and location of masonry been checked to ensure they align with the specifications outlined in the plans?
Mortar Mix Proportion and Joints: Is the mortar mix proportion and joint thickness in the masonry as per the standard specifications?
Minimize Wastage: Has mortar wastage been minimized through timely application, conservation practices and efficient reutilization?
Dimensions and Geometry: Have the dimensions, plumbness, levelness and right angles of the masonry been checked and verified?
Check for Bond: Is the bond pattern of the masonry, such as stretcher bond, english bond, etc., checked for adherence to the design specifications?
Openings for Doors and Windows: Are the sizes and openings for doors and windows verified to match the design specifications?

Work Done Date: Has the work done date been prominently displayed on the masonry walls?
Finish and Cleanliness: Is the masonry finish and cleanliness of the completed work checked and ensured?

Sill concrete: Has sill concrete been provided for all window openings as per standards?

Work Area Cleaning: Is the work area cleaned and free of debris?

Protection of Module Boxes: Are module boxes and distribution boards (DB) adequately protected?
MEP Clearance: Has MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) clearance been received before proceeding with plastering?
Mixing sheets: Arranged for mixing sheet for mortar mixing?
Material arrangement: Arranged for Fibre mesh/ Chicken mesh/ Corner bead as per approved specification?
Plastering area confirmation: Confirmed rough plastering area, No plastering area in ceiling etc?

Mesh in Joints: Is the mesh in joints of repair portions, concrete and block joints checked?
